content:
Samir: Hey team — quick heads up: Ari Mendes is starting today as a Software Engineer on Eng Runtime. Ari, welcome! Drop any setup/questions here and we'll get you squared away. :tada:
Ari Mendes: Hi all — excited to be here! Quick Q: who should I ping for mac setup and VPN access?
Maya: @Ari Mendes welcome! For mac + MDM, ping #help-it or DM me. For VPN/VPC access, loop in Eliot.
Eliot: @Ari I can do the VPN bits. If you paste your seat email I'll add you to the infra groups. Also add me if you need Dedicated cluster creds later.
Ari Mendes: thanks — ari.mendes@redwood.com
Zoe Liu: Hello Ari! I run the welcome sticker drops — what sticker pack do you want? We have ramen, puffer, and tiny GPUs. Ramen > GPUs imo. :ramen:
Ari Mendes: ramen please :ramen: and maybe a tiny GPU for my desk collection :)
Noor: Welcome Ari! If you want a mentor pair for the first week, I can pair on runtime tests Tue/Thu.
Samir: Nice — @Noor that's great. Ari, also FYI our onboarding checklist is in #devex/onboarding (pin). Quick commands:
Devex Bot: 
```
/help-it submit_ticket --type=workstation --priority=normal
/onboard assign-mentor @Noor
```
Ari Mendes: Got it, submitted the ticket. One more random thing — fun fact about me: I judge local ramen competitions.
Zoe Liu: omg yes. Ramen judge = immediate friend. Welcome again!
Eliot: Added you to infra-remote and allowed groups. Expect an invite to Okta and the VPN client in ~10m. Ping if anything fails.
Maya: MDM invite sent, you should see the enrollment email. Let me know if the company cert modal is weird on first boot.
Samir: Perfect — thanks everyone. Ari, we'll do a quick intro at the eng runtime standup in 30m if you can join (10m slot).
Ari Mendes: I'll be there, thanks all :heart:
